# Graphdozer Counseling (Sandbox Test Practice)

> Educational demonstration of a solo counseling practice in Cary, NC.

Jordan Vance, MA, LCMHC holds NC test license TEST-00000 in this sandbox.
Office hours are Monday–Thursday, 11 a.m.–6 p.m. Eastern.
Telehealth is limited to clients physically located in NC during a session.
The sandbox is waitlisting new clients. Intake appointments are closed.
[Practice overview](https://graphdozer.com/)

## Fees and insurance

| Service | Fee |
| --- | ---: |
| Intake | $250 |
| Individual session | $175 |
| Couples session | $205 |
| Late cancellation | $100 |
| 15-minute consultation | $0 |

Listed carriers for individual therapy include Aetna, BlueCross BlueShield of NC (BCBSNC), NC State Health Plan.
Couples therapy is private pay.

This is a sandbox test site for educational/demonstration purposes only and does not provide medical or mental health advice. If you are in crisis, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline), text HOME to 741741, or call 911.
